title: Additive functors preserve finite coproducts
statement: Let $C$ and $D$ be preadditive categories [def-weil-preadditive-category] and let $F:C\to D$ be an additive functor [def-weil-pbc-additive-functor]. For every finite family $(X_j)_{j\in J}$ in $C$, whenever its coproduct exists, the image family $(F X_j)_{j\in J}$ has a coproduct in $D$, and the canonical comparison from that coproduct to $F(\coprod_{j\in J}X_j)$ is an isomorphism. Equivalently, $F$ preserves finite coproducts.
